lines.text: Hi, I am Michelle, co-founder of Transglobal Food Tech. This is my automated guide. Ask me about what we do, our farmers, our brands, or how to work with us.

Transglobal Food Tech is a food, nutrition and wellness holding company. We connect farmers, natural ingredients, innovation and consumers. We work directly with farmers, source their produce and create value through innovative food, beverage, nutraceutical and natural cosmetic products.

We believe farmers should be an integral part of the value chain. We work directly with farmers and source their produce, helping create sustainable opportunities for them. Our aim is to reduce agricultural wastage, increase value from their produce and connect local farms to national and international markets.

We operate across the entire food and wellness value chain: fresh and natural ingredients, fruits and vegetables, spices and botanicals, food and beverages, freeze-dried foods, nutraceuticals and functional nutrition, wellness products and natural cosmetics.

OSOEAZY is our first consumer brand. It brings together food, beverages, functional nutrition, nutraceuticals, wellness and innovative everyday products, making better choices easier. Transglobal is being built as a multi-brand platform, and more brands are being built.

Our vision is to build a global portfolio of food, nutrition, wellness and natural-product brands that creates value from farm to consumer. Our purpose is to make better nutrition part of everyday life, supporting farmers and creating healthier, more sustainable choices for people everywhere.

Transglobal was founded by Visha Michelle Iyer and Aditya Mahimkar. Michelle has worked with NGOs, farmers and government initiatives and trained in food dehydration. Aditya is a social-impact advocate who has worked extensively with NGOs, youth and farming communities.
We are in Mumbai: 401, Jyoti Building, 15th Road, Santacruz (West), Mumbai 400054, India.

Once upon a time, on a farm in India…
A Healthier Tomorrow Grows Today.
Building brands. Supporting farmers. Creating better products for a healthier world.
There was a farmer whose fields gave more than her village could ever eat.
But the road to market was long, and each season good food was lost along the way.
So a small company made a promise: nothing good should go to waste. Fruits were dried to keep their goodness. Spices were blended and leaves were brewed.
And the harvest set sail, from India to the world.
Two founders keep that promise still.
And everyone ate well, ever after.
Better Food. Stronger Farmers. Healthier Lives.
By connecting farmers to innovation and innovation to consumers, we can create better value for everyone.

Visha Michelle Iyer.

Entrepreneur and creative thinker who has worked with NGOs, farmers and government initiatives. Her interest in food processing grew from seeing farmers lose significant value when fresh produce was discarded because it could not reach markets economically. Her training in food dehydration led her to explore ways of preserving agricultural produce, reducing wastage and creating greater value from what farmers grow.
